_about: First day in force of acts whose vigência clause defers it past publication, read from each act's own text in the scrape. Covers acts whose deferral ends after 2009 (no OAB notice date is earlier). in_force null: on publication, except the targets. A target's article is an act id (all its articles) or an article id; its label limits it to one provision and those nested under it. Day counts follow LC 95/1998 art. 8 § 1 (publication day + N days); months and years land on the same day of the month. Clauses deferring only the 'produção de efeitos' are not entry into force and are left out.
